decisions.reason: After several years without stronger visible traction, this sensor module likely falls below aspiration relative to the firm's better-established core modules, so we would redeploy its resources.
As the next-generation replacement in an established voltage-measurement line, it is a core platform component that likely remains at or above aspiration.
The MQTT proxy strengthens the software ecosystem at low carrying cost, so boundedly rational management would keep it unless its usage clearly proved disappointing.
The CAN bus interface fits industrial and embedded applications important to German customers, making it a strategically complementary module worth keeping while returns remain acceptable.

The touch panel accessory is relatively peripheral to the firm's core modular sensing and control business, and after extended uncertain demand it is the clearest candidate to fall below aspiration and be cut.
